answer_text: The XOps Network Playbook – SCIM Provisioning Failed describes three troubleshooting moves for scheduled SCIM provisioning failures: 1) Validate the SCIM connection between the IdP and CMA and ensure credentials are correct; 2) Verify CMA SCIM provisioning configuration and the user/attribute mappings; 3) Review the SCIM provisioning job history/logs and re-run the provisioning after addressing any issues.
